title.zh: Clarity Act Stalls in Senate as Crypto Bill Fails to Clear Key Vote
title.en: Clarity Act Stalls in Senate as Crypto Bill Fails to Clear Key Vote

current_state.zh: The U.S. Senate rejected a 60-vote cloture motion to proceed on the Clarity Act by 49-50, stalling the federal crypto market-structure bill after months of negotiations over ethics rules and stablecoin rewards.
current_state.en: The U.S. Senate rejected a 60-vote cloture motion to proceed on the Clarity Act by 49-50, stalling the federal crypto market-structure bill after months of negotiations over ethics rules and stablecoin rewards.
